display.purpose: Elegant serifs for primary headers only.

body.purpose: Readable sans-serif for UI copy, tables, and settings.

label.purpose: Monospace numbers and values in option sheets.

shadows.name: active-focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Subtle gold glow on active focus elements.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Smooth exponential easing for socket events and hover transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard gold button for primary terminal actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D4AF37; color: #0B0C0E; border: none; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F3CD4F; }

components.name: Data Container
components.description: Obsidian satin plate holding scanner tables and telemetry panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121316; border: 1px solid #222428; border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; color: #E2E2E2; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #7B7D82; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview: This design system establishes a premium, institutional-grade visual interface for PROJECT: SCYLLA. It shifts the scanner away from gamer-centric 'neon cyberpunk' tropes and repositions it as an elite, high-performance financial cockpit.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained Luxury: Gold and graphite tones.
Surgical Density: High data visibility with fine borders.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary gold accent must not exceed 10% of any given screen area.

rules.name: The Signal-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Do not pair green/red neon alongside gold. Calls are chrome, puts are coral red.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All containers and widgets sit on the same horizontal plane. Shadows are forbidden.

dos: Do format all financial data and option metrics in monospace font.
Do highlight whale volume/OI anomalies with a solid gold tag or a fine gold border overlay.
donts: Don't use neon cyan, fluorescent green, or bright purple gradients.
Don't use decorative scanlines or animate elements on hover.
